title: The authz-policy-admin schema.
description: JSON Schema for the authz-policy-admin chart values.

ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION.description: Artifact descriptor version which is installed
ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION.title: The ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION schema

IMAGE_REPOSITORY.description: Image repository of the service without the tag; the image is IMAGE_REPOSITORY:TAG
IMAGE_REPOSITORY.title: The IMAGE_REPOSITORY schema

DEPLOYMENT_VERSION.description: Deployment version. Provided if facade/bluegreen mode is true
DEPLOYMENT_VERSION.title: The DEPLOYMENT_VERSION schema

READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.description: Read-only container file system is enabled
READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.title: The READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED schema

MANAGED_BY.title: The MANAGED_BY schema
MANAGED_BY.description: The tool being used to manage the operation of an application

DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.title: The DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID schema
DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.description: Unique identifier of deployment session used to track e2e deploy activity

MESH_ROUTES_ENABLED.title: The MESH_ROUTES_ENABLED schema
MESH_ROUTES_ENABLED.description: Registers the stub's policy-upload API, /access/v1/simplifiedPolicies, on the internal gateway through a Mesh CR handled by core-operator. Set to false on a cluster without core-operator.

IMAGE_PULL_POLICY.title: The IMAGE_PULL_POLICY schema
IMAGE_PULL_POLICY.description: Image pull policy of every container. IfNotPresent suits immutable pipeline tags; set Always where a moving tag must win on every restart

LOG_LEVEL.title: The LOG_LEVEL schema
LOG_LEVEL.description: Root log level of the service, passed to the container as LOGGING_LEVEL_ROOT

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_PORT.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_PORT schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_PORT.description: HTTP port of the stub, used for the container port and the Service port

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_DATA_DIR.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_DATA_DIR schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_DATA_DIR.description: Directory where the stub keeps the uploaded policies and PIPs; it is the mount path of its volume

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID.description: tenantId the export gives the policies and PIPs uploaded without a tenant; set it to the ID the agent resolves its default tenant to

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_SIZE.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_SIZE schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_SIZE.description: Size of the PersistentVolumeClaim that holds the uploaded policies

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_CLASS.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_CLASS schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_CLASS.description: StorageClass of that claim. Empty uses the cluster default

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_RETAIN.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_RETAIN schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_RETAIN.description: Keeps the PersistentVolumeClaim with the uploaded policies when the release is uninstalled (helm.sh/resource-policy: keep)

CPU_REQUEST.title: The CPU_REQUEST schema
CPU_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of CPU the container will use to start

CPU_LIMIT.title: The CPU_LIMIT schema
CPU_LIMIT.description: Defines maximum amount of CPU the container can use

MEMORY_REQUEST.title: The MEMORY_REQUEST schema
MEMORY_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of memory the container will use to start

MEMORY_LIMIT.title: The MEMORY_LIMIT schema
MEMORY_LIMIT.description: Defines maximum amount of memory the container can use

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_REQ.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_REQUEST schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_REQ.description: Defines minimum amount of ephemeral storage the stub container will use to start

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_LIM.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_LIMIT schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_LIM.description: Defines maximum amount of ephemeral storage the stub container is allowed to use
